stories.title: ‘Industrial-scale’ noise from Aldi Broughton fridges keeping residents awake, planning committee told
stories.summary: A resident broke down in tears at Flintshire’s Planning Committee while explaining the impact of ‘industrial-scale’ noise from Aldi refrigeration units near her home. Judith Richards’ home is adjacent to the Aldi store at Broughton Shopping Park which has just submitted a retrospective planning application to replace its ageing refrigeration system. stories.title: New Treasury rules could close the court challenge route for projects like Connah’s Quay low carbon power station
stories.summary: The UK Government has proposed giving Parliament a direct vote on major energy projects and restricting the grounds on which those decisions can be challenged in court. stories.title: Nearly three quarters of 11 to 17 year olds saw harmful content online, Ofcom finds
stories.summary: Nearly three-quarters of 11 to 17 year olds have seen harmful content online in the past month, according to research published by Ofcom on Thursday. stories.title: Welsh rivers charity says new Clean Water Bill ‘not enough’ for Wales
stories.summary: The Welsh charity that represents the rivers trust covering the Dee has said the UK Government’s new Clean Water Bill is not enough for Wales. stories.title: Nursing students in Wales pushed into poverty despite existing support, RCN warns
stories.summary: Nursing staff in Wales say staffing levels are not matching the complexity of care patients now need, with too many shifts operating without enough registered nurses to deliver safe and effective care, the Royal College of Nursing says.
